latest.title: Visiting Taiwan w/ Jensen Huang | Lex Fridman
latest.desc:
I've been traveling the world a bit. One of the most incredible experiences was getting to visit Taiwan with Jensen Huang. It was wild 🤯 Huge crowds, insanely good street food at night markets, and of course a lot of good conversations across many days. I caught some of it on video, this is it.
